steps.en: Add one language binding to your test project
steps.zh: 给你的测试项目加一门语言绑定

steps.en: Open a session on the browser you target
steps.zh: 在目标浏览器上开一个会话

steps.en: Resolves, downloads and launches the matching driver for that browser
steps.zh: 解析、下载并拉起匹配的浏览器驱动

steps.en: Drive the page like a user: navigate, find elements, type, click
steps.zh: 像用户一样操作页面：导航、找元素、填写、点击

steps.en: Set your own waits — the calls return immediately
steps.zh: 自己设定等待——命令是立刻返回的

steps.en: Every command lands as a native event; one code runs on Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari
steps.zh: 每条命令都落成原生事件，四个浏览器跑同一套代码

value.en: One automation API drives real Chrome, Firefox, Edge and Safari — the W3C-standard way to do cross-browser E2E
value.zh: 一套 API 驱动真实的四大浏览器——W3C 标准的跨浏览器端到端自动化

sources: selenium.dev Install a Selenium library (pip install selenium; bindings 4.49.0 across Maven/NuGet/gem/npm)

selenium.dev Write your first Selenium script (driver = webdriver.Chrome(); driver.get("https://www.selenium.dev/selenium/web/web-form.html"); driver.implicitly_wait(0.5); find_element/send_keys/click)
selenium.dev Selenium Manager docs section (driver resolution/download) and WebDriver overview ('WebDriver drives a browser natively, as a user would')
